name_en: Hangzhou Gaosheng Garment Co., Ltd. (pinyin; official English name not found)
name_cn: 杭州高盛制衣有限公司
main_products: Men's and women's clothing (Canton Fair category). Exact products not found.
woven_evidence: Not confirmed. Its name uses 制衣 (garment making), and it is listed in the 男女装 zone.

canton_fair.evidence_note: The official table of approved joint exhibitors (联营参展) for the 138th Canton Fair lists it as the production company (生产企业) partnered with exhibitor 浙江东方集团茂业进出口有限公司, a trading company, in the 男女装 zone (5 booths).

notes: It is officially classed as a production company, but it exhibits under a trading company's booth rather than its own, so buyers may meet the trader first. Its products and woven focus need checking. The English name is a transliteration.
